items.title: Novartis: More Pain on the Way?
items.summary: Can it get any worse for  Novartis’  U.S. stock?  The Swiss company said Tuesday that del-desiran, part of a recent acquisition, reached the end of the line in a trial for a rare neuromuscular disease.  The drugmaker’s U.S.-listed shares slumped 13% to $139.01 Tuesday.
